::: {.nf-es}
**404.** Aquí no crece nada: solo arena y sol. Recuerda usar protector solar y sombrero.

[Volver al inicio](/){.btn .btn-primary} [Read in English](/en/){.btn .btn-outline-primary}

::: {.nf-en}
**404.** Nothing grows here: only sand and sun. Remember your sunscreen and hat.

[Back to home](/en/){.btn .btn-primary} [Leer en español](/){.btn .btn-outline-primary}
:::

```{=html}
<script>
/* GitHub Pages serves this same page for every missing address, so the language is chosen here:
   English when the missing page was under /en/, when the visitor came from an English page,
   or when the browser prefers English; Spanish otherwise. */
document.addEventListener("DOMContentLoaded", function () {
  var en = /^\/en\//.test(location.pathname) || /\/en\//.test(document.referrer) ||
           (!/^es/i.test(navigator.language || "") && /^en/i.test(navigator.language || ""));
  document.documentElement.lang = en ? "en" : "es";
  document.querySelector(en ? ".nf-es" : ".nf-en").hidden = true;
  var toggle = document.querySelector("a.lang-toggle");
  if (toggle) toggle.setAttribute("href", en ? "/" : "/en/");
  if (!en) return;
  document.title = "Page not found – Beatriz M. Meriño";
  /* the single 404 page has the Spanish menu: switch it to the English pages */
  var map = {"Inicio": ["Home", "/en/"], "Investigación": ["Research", "/en/research.html"],
             "Publicaciones": ["Publications", "/en/publications.html"], "Software": ["Software", "/en/software.html"],
             "Galería": ["Gallery", "/en/gallery.html"]};
  document.querySelectorAll(".navbar .nav-link").forEach(function (a) {
    var t = a.querySelector(".menu-text"); var k = t && t.textContent.trim();
    if (map[k]) { t.textContent = map[k][0]; a.setAttribute("href", map[k][1]); }
  });
  var brand = document.querySelector(".navbar-brand"); if (brand) brand.setAttribute("href", "/en/");
  var right = document.querySelector(".nav-footer-right");
  if (right) right.innerHTML = right.innerHTML.replace("Hecho con", "Built with").replace("alojado en", "hosted on");
});
</script>
```
:::
